remarks: Oversized(1170sqft) and updated 2 bedroom, 2 bathroom condo in hi rise bldg in the heart of downtown Stamford! Eat in kitchen w/ stainless steel Chef's appliances- stove, dishwasher, microwave, breakfast bar that opens into sunfilled living area with walls of glass and sliders to private, expansive balcony! Dining area.  Large Master Bedroom suite w/ large double closets, luxurious bathroom with bathtub, and access to patio. Generous sized second bedroom with ample closets and modern second bathroom. Gleaming hardwood floors, private storage room w/ in unit washer/dryer, air conditioning, clubroom, bicycle storage,1 off street gated parking, pet welcome! Walk to train, shops, nightlife, minutes to highways and beaches! Must see unit in fabulous mid city location!
